title: tastewatch digest: 2026-10-05
description:
First tastewatch run; no prior digest. Window: main, 2026-09-28 00:24 to 2026-10-05 00:24 UTC, 27 merged commits. Sample of 6: 3 largest by diff size + 3 from the middle band (median size and nearest neighbors, spread across three merge days). No release commits in window; no patrol-produced commits (no nightwatch/gatewatch/ratchetwatch children, plans.jsonl empty). Judged against charter-embedded articles: docs/CONSTITUTION.md is missing (separate priority-1 seed filed).

1) Verdicts
d4fdf98 feat: migrate content to generic owner-led blocks (#35) - conforms (I, IV). New validate_blocks.mjs plus fixture-driven rejection tests enforce the contract, not its shape.
40808f8 feat(content): adaptive service inquiry routing (#45) - diverges (I). +14 lines to .github/workflows/dispatch-web-content-deploy.yml bundled under a content-routing title.
dc06786 Translate WEB4 homepage and method pages into English and Catalan (#41) - conforms (I). Locale structure checks are real parity assertions, not snapshots.
c91de84 fix: use the canonical RUDE project cover (#39) - conforms (I, IV). Regression test on canonical media ID and alt text.
c1d3dc5 content(es): align methods FAQ with WEB4 (#36) - conforms (I). Contract test pins the approved question set and rejects pendiente placeholders.
d6a5407 Route methods package inquiries (#43) - conforms (I). Regression coverage for all three locale mappings.

Fix-on-fix chain (whole window): c598d8b (#38, Sep 30 18:11) was patched twice inside 14 minutes - c91de84 (#39, 18:19, malformed empty-media images// URLs) and ea2bca9 (#40, 18:25, showcase order swap; commit body admits the template-order-only test missed it). Missing test class: media/asset contract for newly featured content (non-empty mediaId plus per-section position). Both fixes added regressions; class now closed.

2) Divergence rate: 1/6 = 17 percent. Last week: no prior digest (first run), no baseline.

3) Most important divergence - 40808f8. Title claims content routing; the diff also alters the deploy pipeline: dispatch-web-content-deploy.yml gains a checkout of the pinned content revision, setup-bun, and a bun run quality:content step before the web token mint (lines ~46-64 of the workflow in that commit). That is a consumer-observable infrastructure change, mentioned in the body but absent from the title, and it is the only sampled divergent commit. The rest of the PR (service matrix in validate_inquiries.mjs, legacy-field rejection, fixture tests) is strong and on-scope.

4) Auditor precision: gatewatch 0 seeds filed; ratchetwatch 0 seeds filed. Precision ratios undefined for both (0/0); no data for autonomy promotion this week.

5) Proposed amendment (proposal only, per Article IX): when the constitution is restored or re-enacted, add an article - changes to .github/workflows/ are limited to commits typed chore or ci, or the workflow file must be named in the title. Executable gate: a pre-merge script failing when changed paths intersect .github/workflows/ AND the commit type is not chore or ci AND no workflow filename appears in the subject.

6) Trajectory: holding - behavior-based tests with fixtures and zero mock/snapshot theater, clean comment discipline (zero code comments, zero JSON $comment entries), one silent infra change, and the population operating without its ratified charter.

title: gatewatch: pre-existing-failure language in PR verification (bd16ca5, Article I)
description: Evidence: commit bd16ca5 ('docs(mulch): confirm pinned export contract (#54)', 2026-10-08 14:00 +0200), file .mulch/expertise/content-contract.jsonl. The PR body Verification section reads: 'mulch doctor -> 16 checks passed; existing stale lifecycle warning remains'. Article I (red-gate rationalization) treats any pre-existing-failure / unrelated-failure language in a commit message or PR body as a finding even when the claim is true, because a merged exception needs an explicit sanctioned reference, not an assertion. The diff itself is honest and matches the title (single-line outcome annotation on an expertise record). Remediation direction: attach the tracker/seed reference for the stale lifecycle warning in the record or commit message so the exception is attributable; no gate was bypassed, severity is low.
